title: attempt.resolved
description: Terminal ledger row for one dispatch (plan section 4.4 step 1, transition N-T16). Exactly one is emitted per dispatch, from OutcomeHandler::handle, regardless of which terminal path resolved it. The canonical Rust type is AttemptResolvedFields in src/telemetry/mod.rs; this fixture is the versioned contract its serialized `data` object must satisfy. Schema version 3 adds commits_before_deadline (N-T25); version 2 added decomposed (N-T46) and costed (N-T47).

schema_version.description: Version of this row schema. Bump — and version the fixture — whenever a field changes meaning or availability.

attempt_id.description: UUIDv7 minted at dispatch start. Dispatch-local and flagged provisional until N-T03 resolves attempts against beads.

provisional.description: True until accepted claim-time provenance ties the dispatch ID to a real attempt (N-T03). Consumers must not treat a provisional row as authoritative: provisional rows are excluded from learning evidence and SLOs (plan section 4.4 step 1, Gate A).

workspace.description: Workspace directory the attempt ran in.

bead_revision_start.description: HEAD SHA captured before the agent ran, so downstream commits can be attributed to the attempt. Absent when the SHA could not be captured.

claim_revision.description: Backend bead revision observed immediately after the claim landed.

assignee.description: Exact assignee identity captured with the claim.

claim_epoch.description: Backend lease/fencing epoch captured with the claim.

claim_handle.description: Credential-free claim identity and negotiated lease facts at attempt resolution.

backend_capabilities.description: Negotiated backend capability snapshot used by the attempt.

worker.description: Worker identifier that ran the attempt.

adapter.description: Agent adapter that executed the attempt (e.g. "claude-code-glm-4.7").

model.description: Model identifier from the adapter config. Absent when the adapter publishes none.

prompt_template.description: Prompt template that built the dispatch prompt (e.g. "pluck", or "split" for the auto-split template).

context_manifest_hash.description: Hash of the ContextManifest the attempt saw. Absent until N-T10 ships manifest hashing.

gate_results.description: Per-gate verdicts, ordered by gate name. Empty when no gate ran. Kept unchanged when the attempt resolves decomposed.

duration_ms.description: 0 until per-gate timing exists; the field is part of the schema so consumers can rely on its presence.

outcome.description: Semantic verdict: what the work did, separate from what the lifecycle will do about it. `decomposed` means the attempt split its bead into children instead of delivering the work: no verified credit and no failure (ADR-030). `needs_human` means an operator-only handoff parked the bead without a work failure.

requested_action.description: Bead lifecycle action the handler requested (e.g. "Completed", "Released", "Deferred").

confirmed_state.description: Authoritative post-action bead state. Reserved for the resolver's re-read (plan section 3.2 step 5); absent while only the request is known.

tokens_in.description: Input tokens reported by the agent's token extractor. Absent when unreported.

tokens_out.description: Output tokens reported by the agent's token extractor. Absent when unreported.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD: the result envelope's reported cost when the agent wrote one, otherwise the pricing table applied to the per-turn usage in its stream. Absent when it could not be established.

provider_errors.description: Categorical provider-error observations counted from the Claude stream; error bodies are never stored.

provider_error_classes.description: Map of stable provider error classes to counts; raw provider bodies are never stored.

max_response_gap_ms.description: Longest gap between consecutive assistant records in the Claude stream, in milliseconds.

costed.description: Whether estimated_cost_usd was established (N-T47, ADR-030). false means the cost is unknown (no usage was reported, or the model has no price), never that the attempt was free; consumers treat the row's cost as unknown.

commits.description: Commit SHAs created in the workspace during the attempt.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time from claim to resolution.

terminal_reason.description: Short machine-readable reason the attempt reached its terminal state (e.g. "gate:fmt", "exit_code:1", "signal:9", "decomposed:split_template"). Absent on a verified success.

exit_code.description: Agent process exit code. Observation only: it says what the process did, never whether the work was accepted — `outcome` carries that.

override.description: Operator correction attached to the terminal attempt, when dispatch was interrupted by a human stop.

wip_patch.description: Durable working-tree recovery patch captured before a timeout, crash, or interruption release.

commits_before_deadline.description: Commits the attempt landed before its checkpoint mark — 75% of the effective adapter wall-clock deadline (N-T25). null when there was no wall-clock cap, the attempt start is unknown, or commit timestamps could not be read: unknown, never zero.
